services.name: Platinum Party Bus - Private Tour
services.desc: Most Unique way to see Nashville 2 Hours About Whether you’re looking for a quiet scenic tour with family or you’re looking to start the weekend on our one-of-a-kind party, we’re your spot for everything you need. Our tours take up to 30 people across the entire landscape of downtown Nashville. From the Ryman Auditorium and Broadway to the Gulch and Midtown and all the way back to Music Row, Big Green Tours won’t miss an inch of what Nashville has to offer. quotes.text: I came from Utah to visit my dad who lives here in Nashville and he took me on the Big Green Tour downtown. Had a blast. Love the idea of a happy hay ride through town. BYOB with a Tour guide to serve you. Variety of music to party to!

They gave us so much history and information about the city we really enjoyed it. They were fun and and answered all our questions and we had a lot!!! Great and fun tour!! Totally suggest everyone new to Nashville to take this tour.
Amazing time! Tour guides felt like best friends by the end of the tour. Such cool people that introduced us to a side of Nashville that never would have know about otherwise!
this was so much fun!!! we're from New Jersey and we had an amazing time! they were so kind and so nice! I recommend this if your in Nashville! We didn't wanna get off!
